title.narrative: Fiscal Sustainability Support Program II
Programa de Apoyo a la Sostenibilidad Fiscal II

description.narrative: El objetivo es fortalecer la sostenibilidad fiscal por medio del control del gasto y la modernizacin del sistema tributario. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar la efectividad del marco institucional macrofiscal; (ii) aumentar la eficiencia en la gestin del sistema tributario; y (iii) mejorar la eficiencia en la gestin del gasto pblico (empleo, reforma administrativa y pensiones judiciales). La presente operacin corresponde a la segunda de dos operaciones bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP).

The objective of this operation is to strengthen fiscal sustainability by controlling expenditure and modernizing the tax system. The specific objectives are: (i) improving the effectiveness of the macrofiscal institutional framework; (ii) increasing the efficiency of tax system management; and (iii) improving efficiency in public expenditure management (employment, administrative reform, and judicial pensions). This is the second of two operations under the programmatic policy-based loan modality.
Commitment in 2021-05-05
Disbursement in first quarter of 2022
